She folded the note slowly and looked out at the horizon, wondering how many other silences the sea was still keeping.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着。路灯将橙黄色的光晕投在湿漉漉的街道上，偶尔一辆出租车划过，尾灯如流星般消失在拐角。便利店的玻璃门后，收银员靠在柜台上，眼神空洞地盯着荧光灯。楼道里传来婴儿短暂的啼哭，随即又归于寂静。清洁工推着橙色小车，沙沙地扫过梧桐落叶，动作慢而从容，仿佛这座城市是他一个人的。远处工地上的塔吊静止不动，像一个被遗忘的巨人。空气里有露水、柴油和隔夜油烟混合的气息。这是城市最诚实的时刻，所有的表演都已落幕，只剩下最素朴的骨架。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you need to look up.\n• Every recursive function has a \"base case\" — a simple situation where it already knows the answer and stops calling itself, so it doesn't go on forever.\n• Think of nesting dolls: you open a doll to find a smaller one inside, and you keep opening until you find the tiniest one that doesn't open — that tiny doll is the base case."}
